metadata.explanation: Vilsmeier-Haack formylation of the electron-rich 2,3-dihydrobenzofuran ring. Dimethylformamide/phosphorus oxychloride generates the iminium electrophile that formylates the ring para to the ring oxygen; aqueous workup gives the aldehyde. Both the arene core and the formylating reagents are available building blocks verified by exact stock lookup.

literature.note: analogous DMF/POCl3 formylations of activated arenes present in training precedents

metadata.classification_location: C-C bond formation to aromatic ring
metadata.explanation: Duff-type formylation: hexamethylenetetramine with acetic acid condenses with the electron-rich dihydrobenzofuran to give an iminium intermediate, which is hydrolyzed on acidic workup to the aryl aldehyde. Distinct first cut from route 1 (different reagent system and mechanism) although the same in-stock arene is used.

literature.note: HMTA-based aromatic formylations of phenols/activated arenes in training precedents

metadata.explanation: Williamson ether synthesis: phenolate of 3-hydroxybenzaldehyde alkylated by benzyl bromide to install the benzyl ether.

Target benzylic amine made by reductive amination: condensation of ammonia with the 3-(benzyloxy)benzaldehyde followed by reduction gives the primary amine. Aldehyde precursor reached by O-benzylation of 3-hydroxybenzaldehyde.

literature.note: analogous nitro/aldehyde -> nitrile -> amine and aldehyde + ammonia reductive amination precedents
literature.title: Patent US08193184B2

metadata.explanation: Williamson ether synthesis: alkylation of 3-hydroxybenzonitrile phenolate with benzyl bromide to give the benzyl-protected phenol.
Nitrile reduction to the primary benzylic amine; nitrile precursor assembled by benzylation of 3-hydroxybenzonitrile.

literature.note: aryl nitrile -> benzylamine reduction precedent (Raney Ni/LAH)
